    Local selected-corner quotients for BGRS Figures 14--15 #

    BGRS 4.3 takes its Figure-14/15 quotients inside a finite full subcategory of primitive projectives. A finite selection of the chosen primitive idempotents is now represented by its split-basic corner, so these local quotients no longer need to be strengthened to global quotients of the whole algebra.

    This file packages that exact local algebra plumbing. The remaining callback is still the source-specific construction of the displayed diagram and its Hom-bifunctor retraction.
